canDoYue: 你識講房嘈同冷氣，仲識要求換靜啲嘅房。
canDoEn: Report a noisy room and ask for a quieter one.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Good evening, this is Kim at the front desk. How may I help tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 晚安，我係前台 Kim。今晚有咩可以幫你？
dialogue.say: Good evening, this is Kim at the front desk. How may I help tonight?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The air conditioning is very noisy, and I barely slept in this room.
dialogue.glossYue: 部冷氣好嘈，我喺呢間房幾乎瞓唔到。
dialogue.say: The air conditioning is very noisy, and I barely slept in this room.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer up.
dialogue.glossYue: 造成不便，對唔住。我可以派工程師上嚟。
dialogue.say: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer up.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we move to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以搬去靜啲嘅房，再加毛巾同一張被？
dialogue.say: Could we move to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: A calmer room is free upstairs, and I will bring the towels now.
dialogue.glossYue: 樓上有間靜啲嘅房，我而家帶毛巾上嚟。
dialogue.say: A calmer room is free upstairs, and I will bring the towels now.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The air conditioning is still weak, so please ask the engineer to check.
dialogue.glossYue: 部冷氣仍然好弱，唔該叫工程師檢查。
dialogue.say: The air conditioning is still weak, so please ask the engineer to check.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I have noted the noisy area, and the engineer will visit upstairs.
dialogue.glossYue: 我記低嘈嘅位置，工程師會上嚟。
dialogue.say: I have noted the noisy area, and the engineer will visit upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I appreciate the calm rest, the towels, and the warm blanket.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝個安靜休息、毛巾同暖被。
dialogue.say: I appreciate the calm rest, the towels, and the warm blanket.
